criteria.requirement: Add public fragments.extract_section(document,section_id,*,external="error"|"include_notes") selecting one exact real section id into a new document, preserving source/line, nested structure and internal refid/name maps without modifying the old tree. Selected section becomes top level structurally; actual HTML publication must work. Default rejects references outside selection. include_notes appends only referenced external footnote/citation closure and filters backrefs to included ids; external section/unknown targets still error rather than silently including arbitrary chapters. Missing/duplicate IDs and invalid policies fail explicitly. Do not slice rendered HTML, guess titles, fake URLs or claim unimplemented CLI support.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
